stem: In the past, Angus found that his train was late on 15% of his daily journeys to work. Following a timetable change, Angus found that out of 60 randomly chosen days, his train was late on 6 days.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Test at the 10% significance level whether Angus’ train is late less often than it was before the timetable change.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: Angus used his random sample to find an $\alpha\%$ confidence interval for the proportion of days on which his train is late. The upper limit of his interval was 0.150, correct to 3 significant figures.
parts.text: Calculate the value of $\alpha$ correct to the nearest integer.
